title: [Epic] Package-level override: every customization of an installed package lives in its paired <base>.custom package, one declared override shared by code and Studio (supersedes #28130)
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ coordination parent, opened on the maintainer's direct instruction (③) in a desktop session on 2026-10-30, verbatim: 「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」 · 「现在用fable规划新的epic 任务清单。原来的你可以考虑直接关闭」 · 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」. Supersedes #28130.

Epic (coordination parent) · **no `pm:epic`** on this parent or any child — the children are fleet work: each carries `pm:queue` (or its own state) and its `domain:*` lane, and the domain seats claim them under the normal protocol. Maintainer, 2026-10-31, verbatim: 「这些卡都可以放回车队开发吧」 · 「注意不能写epic车队才会认领」. Coordinating session: `040dfd80-c4c9-411b-895c-698e785a6848` (desktop, `hotlong`) · ⛔ not a claim on any child.

Territory (declared): `docs/adr/0146-*.md` (rewritten in place) and the status lines of ADR-0005/0009/0048/0126/0131/0141 · `packages/spec` (override declaration, `.custom` pairing constants, field-patch whitelist) · `packages/metadata-protocol/src/{protocol-environment-rows.ts,protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts,protocol-authoring-gate.ts,protocol.ts}` (read/write doors) · `packages/runtime/src/domains/{packages.ts,automation.ts}`, `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts` · `packages/services/service-automation/src/{flow-precedence.ts,run-resume.ts,engine.ts}` · `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (extension merge) · `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/{studio-design,metadata-admin,setup}/**`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 已安装软件包（如 HotCRM）的一切定制——改原有的、加新的、扩展对象——都进配对的可写包 `<base>.custom`；「改原有的」= 在 `.custom` 的同名项正文里**显式声明覆盖**，整份替换。写代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制随包导出、进 git、跨环境部署。
- **为什么改：** 10-30 浏览器走查：Studio 改不了只读包；Setup 写的是不随包走的「无包覆盖行」；克隆即双跑；依赖包的同名视图会**静默盖掉**基础包（Studio 看 6 列、用户看 2 列）。ADR-0146 还没开工，直接改写。
- **风险与回滚：** 需推翻 ADR-0126 D1/D4 墙 1、ADR-0131 D6、ADR-0005 五型、ADR-0048 §3.3、ADR-0009 未兑现的版本固定、ADR-0141 D3 的卸载保护推迟——都在 ADR-0146 改写里逐条写明。每张子卡独立 PR，可单独回退。
- **先看：** N-01（ADR-0146 改写）；P0 六张现在可并行，全部进车队（`pm:queue`，各车道认领；整棵子树不挂 `pm:epic`）。
- **两分钟验证：** HotCRM 视图「定制」→ 三处读取同一列集、导出带声明、「恢复包原版」回原样；流程定制只跑新定义、挂起运行按旧版完成；对象加字段落 `.custom`、名为 `xxx__c`；卸载 HotCRM 被拒并点名 `hotcrm.custom`。
- **需要你做的：** 审 N-01 的 ADR PR 并亲手合并。

## Rulings this epic carries (maintainer, 2026-10-30, verbatim)

- D-1 Direction — 「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」
- D-2 Suffix `.custom` — 「同意 后缀改成 .custom」
- D-3 Auto-create, no prompt, dependency on the base declared (from the walkthrough discussion; the ADR records it).
- D-4 Studio customization waits for the override core — 「我建议先等包级覆盖开发完，再考虑这个界面的修改」
- D-5 Item toolbar in Studio, before customization — 「同意新增 2h「Studio 项工具栏」并放在 2a 之前」
- D-7 Setup's item tools belong to Studio — 「setup 右侧这套界面，包括看版本历史的，本身就应该属于 studio」
- Q1–Q8 — 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」: undeclared same-name refused at publish · declaration in the item body · real version pinning for flows · explicit `<base_ns>_custom` namespace, never derived · package-less overlay writes closed after migration · clone kept only as "new similar" into `.custom` · base-field changes limited to a display-property whitelist · Packaged automation retired after the ledger switch and the landing counts.
- ADR — 「adr 146还没开始开发，可以直接改」 (ADR-0146 is rewritten in place; PR #28145 folds into N-01).
- Extension fields — 「扩展字段用 __c 后缀，只有 .custom 包能用。」
- Fleet — 「这些卡都可以放回车队开发吧」 · 「注意不能写epic车队才会认领」 (2026-10-31): every child is dispatched by its domain lane; nothing in this subtree carries `pm:epic`.
- Ordering — 「四个小问题 同意」: flow customization waits for real version pinning (no interim publish gate); the action ledger switch stays out of this epic (#27842/#27504); no new `area:` label; #28145 folds into N-01.

## Cut after N-01 merges (plan of record, not cards yet)

Each is filed into its domain lane's `pm:queue` when cut, with `Blocked-by:` where the order below says so.

- **P1 override core** (filed 2026-10-31; ready now: N-06, N-08, N-12): N-06 #28406 change note + actor name · N-08 #28404 spec: override declaration, `.custom` constants, namespace rule, `__c` reservation · N-09 #28410 write gate — only `.custom` declares (#28390 ruling A), refuse undeclared / out-of-closure / excluded type / a dependent's `overrides`, at publish, `os validate` and install · N-10 #28409 one effective read across package-less, base-named, layered, list and export; a withdrawn public form stays withdrawn (#28238 list half) · N-11 #28412 flow override · N-12 #28405 real flow version pinning · N-13 #28407 `.custom` ensure door · N-14 #28408 uninstall protection for the pair · N-15 #28411 per-package customization read · N-16 #28413 migrate package-less overlay rows, then close that write.
- **P2 Studio customization** (filed 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule and cards reviewed by Fable; ready now: N-23a, N-26a): N-16b #28576 close the package-less write + remove the overlay link (split from N-16 #28413, which is now the migration ceremony only, so no release lands between a closed write and Studio's replacement; ← N-16a, N-17, N-25) · N-17 #28562 customize view / dashboard / report (replaces #28147) · N-18 #28570 customize a flow · N-19 #28572 base + `.custom` as one surface · N-20a #28563 permission-set "new similar" door → `.custom` · N-20b #28573 its Studio UI · N-21 #28149 clone door → "new similar" · N-22 #28567 Studio "new similar" on a flow · N-23a #28560 spec: per-field display patch slot · N-23b #28564 `__c` judge at every door (incl. marketplace install) · N-23d #28565 patch merge into the base object · N-23e #28574 object-extension write path into `.custom` · N-23c #28575 Studio add-field on a base object · N-24 #28566 landing counts · N-25 #28569 email template / translation editors into Studio.
- **P3:** N-26a #28561 All metadata area in Studio (browse half, ready now) · N-26b #28568 its "customized / added" marks · N-28 #28578 Setup → Metadata redirects, Packaged automation's flows half retired (← N-17, N-20b, N-22, N-24, N-25, N-26a; item 2 waits on decision M-1 #28559) · N-29 #28579 QA checklist + live e2e through the Studio door · N-30 #28577 skills and docs (after #28509).
- **Release safety** (schedule review): do not cut a release after N-13 #28407 merges and before #28511 merges; N-16b's changeset is major and its release note tells operators to run N-16a's `os migrate` first.
